question: How far-reaching is the attracting power claimed for the practitioner through this visualization?
premises: The practitioner performs the prescribed visualization.
The text claims even Śacī can be brought.
An ordinary human woman is presented as a lesser case.
inference: The mantra-practitioner can bring even Śacī, so bringing any other human woman is certainly possible.
plain_english: The mantra-practitioner can bring even Śacī; what then of any other human woman?
